scope: 12 frozen file-outcome contract cases only, run as an --ids subset of the same corpus/scorer; not the full 162-case corpus and not demo acceptance

changes.change: bare Gemma call:name{args} recovery anchored to a whole LINE instead of the whole response, so a call emitted after prose is dispatched instead of leaking as spoken text
changes.frozen_failure: a:ms_calc_and_save emits bare call:write_file syntax inside prose; no write is dispatched.

changes.change: append_file line-separates: a newline is inserted when the existing file does not end with one and the appended text does not start with one
changes.frozen_failure: Both text list tasks concatenate items without line separators; exact contract still fails.

speech_unchanged_reason: every speech failure is a wrong filename or wrong content from the spoken request, or a turn that stops after the first tool — the frozen phoneme audit and ASR diagnostic already attribute these to the ear/fixture, not to call dispatch
text_original_scorer_note: b:ms_write_append_read routes append_file twice instead of write_file+append_file; the ordered-tool grader fails it while the actual file outcome passes
decision: Both fixes are correctness fixes with runnable checks and are kept. Text file outcomes 10/12 -> 12/12. Speech stays 1/12, so the frozen demo suite action score does not move.
